summary: Linn County, OR fire patrol lookout 11 mi NE of Sweet Home; build year disputed (1912 vs 1937); gone, with no site description or public access found.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts: 1912 (Osbornes Project; Forest Lookouts quotes a 1912 Morning Oregonian item) vs 1937 (firetower.org, firelookout.com). Photos dated August 1, 1933 show a lookout before the 1937 date; the story reports both dates and does not pick one. Do not merge with the Jefferson County Bald Peter Mountain site (Warm Springs reservation, 1933 pole tower, destroyed in a 1943 fire; firetower.org and firelookout.com baldpeter33b): that is a different lookout with a different registry entry. No source gives current site condition, visibility or public access. Removal date is not given anywhere. Staffing evidence is one sentence (Green Peter fire patrolman).
